title: Postcards and Weather
author: Wren Ravensworth
blurb: Rosalind Coldharbour, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, has spent seven years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
